# ICU rather than Chinese decides it: `Intl.Segmenter` cuts 平方厘米 into 平方
# and 厘米, so the word cannot be read back and is not printed. It renders
# through its Latin symbol instead, which a Chinese page sets anyway.
# No space between the number and the unit, on input or output. The separators
# 平米 is the colloquial reading of the square metre. It reads and is never
# The myriad. Chinese counts in ten-thousands, so 万 is a magnitude word in its
# own right and 一万 is one of them rather than ten of a thousand.
# The word operators need whitespace around them even though Chinese is
# written without any; 到 and 换算 do not.
